description: Custom A2UI component catalog for the Aerospace Quality & Reliability Intelligence agent. Renders BigQuery-connector-backed defect search results natively inside Gemini Enterprise (inline beginRendering/surfaceUpdate pattern).

components.name: SeverityBadge
components.description: A compact colored badge for a defect's severity_level.

components.name: DefectRow
components.description: One row of the defect results table, mapping 1:1 to a BigQuery defects record.

components.name: DefectResultsTable
components.description: Card containing a scrollable table of DefectRow entries plus a result-count header. This is the primary surface the agent emits for any defect search or query.

components.name: SeverityBreakdownChoicePicker
components.description: Single-select chip picker letting the user narrow a defect result set by severity_level or aircraft_model with one tap instead of typing a follow-up message.
